findings.text: follow-on: _read_sol_ledger now reads the receipt key 'clip_mode' (was 'support_clip_mode'); the committed receipt docs/figures/forward-solve-api/sol-ledger-census/sol-ledger-census.json predates the key rename and is outside this node's write scope, so this read returns None until the receipt is regenerated by the producer. The census read-back loses the mode value; no solve behaviour changes.

follow-on: the gate's test-coverage arm reaches only three of the ten migrated files (plasma_cell_production_ladder via test_production_solver_receipt_trip_alignment.py, profile_coefficients_recompile_audit via test_forward_profile_arguments.py, sol_ledger_current_census via test_sol_ledger_render.py); the other seven -- net_current_scaling_census, plasma_cell_seed_policy, scanned_trip_loop_prototype, solve_profile_kernel_count, wholecell_rows_reposed_fixture, xpoint_cell_allocation_rca, zero_residual_check -- have no importing test, and test_sol_ledger_render exercises only render_from_receipt and stamp_revision, neither of which touches the changed _measure clip_mode path. The equivalence is argued from the with_clip_mode/support_clip_mode default identity, not measured as a bit-identity chord row.

item_verdicts.done_when: Independently reproduced: grep of the ten files at eb3388585 for set_support_clip_mode and support_clip_mode returns no line (exit 1); all ten pass py_compile and each imports with its own worktree path printed as __file__; the three importing test modules re-run at head give 15 passed, 4 passed (1 deselected) and 4 passed, matching the reviewed head logs and the base logs, so added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal - move these ten leaf benchmarks off the process-global support clip mode - is delivered: every set-and-restore block is removed, every operator is built through with_clip_mode, every request carries clip_mode, and the receipts record the solving operator's mode or its pinning constant.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reads complete with matching commits, changed_paths and test_logs; its tests prose carries the per-module base and head commands and results and its evidence_inputs state the gate outcomes. Its negative_control_log is 'none: ...' which is consistent with a refactor that adds no test; the nine-or-so command that actually ran is recorded only as prose, not as baseline_suite/after_suite JSON, so those structured fields are null.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git show --stat eb3388585 lists exactly the ten scoped benchmark files and nothing else; no evidence fragment or figure was written, matching the brief's declaration that the done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: The change is a single committed object reachable in the shared object store and the six gate logs persist under the reviewed run directory; the commit is not yet on main (promotion is the coordinator's step), and the receipt read-back caveat means a regenerated receipt is a prerequisite for the census read to carry a value.
justifications.evidence: Six gate logs (base and head for three modules) exist and the three head arms reproduce exactly; the grep and import gates reproduce independently. The gate is nonetheless a base/head equivalence over a refactor with only three of ten files covered, and rule (c) 'no behaviour change for chord' rests on the structural identity operator.clip_mode=None resolving to support_clip_mode()='chord' rather than on a measured bit-identical chord row.
justifications.fit: The migration follows the merged request-field refactor idiom - additive clip_mode keyword, with_clip_mode on the operator, ForwardSolveRequest(clip_mode=...) - and the commit is a conventional refactor with a body and no plan, sprint or ticket identifiers; added lines carry no banned labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every one of the ten files threads the mode explicitly and the retired accessors are absent from all ten; per-file inspection confirms the previous pinned mode is preserved (plasma_cell_seed_policy stays exact, the chord files stay chord, net_current_scaling_census and plasma_cell_production_ladder thread their argument mode), and ForwardSolveReceipt / census receipts record operator.clip_mode rather than support_clip_mode().
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat returns exactly the ten paths the brief assigned and no other tracked change; no concurrent node's path is touched and the plan is not edited.
